htn_kidney.title: Emerging roles of SIRT6 and its modulators in kidney diseases.
htn_kidney.authors: Ren F, Wang Y, Zhang Y
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于综述研究。核心观点：全球肾脏疾病的发病率和患病率持续上升，对公共卫生构成严峻挑战。 临床提示：SIRT6 是一种 NAD⁺ 依赖性组蛋白脱乙酰酶，在各种病理生理过程中具有广泛的重要调节作用，包括 DNA 修复、染色质可及性、端粒稳定性和糖脂代谢
htn_kidney.abstract: The global incidence and prevalence of kidney diseases continue to rise, posing a serious public health challenge. SIRT6 is an NAD⁺-dependent histone deacetylase with broad essential regulatory roles across various pathophysiological processes, including DNA repair, chromatin accessibility, telomere stability, and glycolipid metabolism. As an epigenetic regulator specifically expressed in kidney tissues, SIRT6 serves as a central mediator of kidney homeostasis. Notably, accumulating evidence has implicated aberrant SIRT6 expression in the onset and development of various kidney diseases, such as acute kidney injury, diabetic kidney disease, hypertensive nephropathy, renal fibrosis, and renal...

portal_hypertension.title: Mathematical Modeling of HDV RNA, HBsAg, and ALT Kinetics in Patients with Compensated Cirrhosis: Insights from 96 Weeks of Bulevirtide Monotherapy.
portal_hypertension.authors: Mhlanga A, Shekhtman L, Cotler SJ
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：38 名患有代偿性肝硬化和临床显着门脉高压 (CSPH) 的 HDV 感染患者接受了 BLV。 临床提示：布勒韦肽 (BLV) 2 mg/天在欧洲被批准用于治疗代偿性慢性丁型肝炎病毒 (HDV) 感染；然而，了解 BLV 单一疗法 96 周下 HDV-RNA、HBsAg 和 ALT 动态的了解还不够
portal_hypertension.abstract: Bulevirtide (BLV) 2 mg/day is approved for the treatment of compensated chronic hepatitis D virus (HDV) infection in Europe; however, understanding HDV-RNA, HBsAg and ALT dynamics under 96 weeks of BLV monotherapy is lacking. 38 HDV-infected patients with compensated cirrhosis and clinically significant portal hypertension (CSPH) received BLV. HDV, ALT, and HBsAg were measured at baseline, weeks 4, 8 and every 8 weeks thereafter. Mathematical modeling was used to explain the observed HDV, ALT, and HBsAg kinetics. Median baseline HDV, HBsAg, and ALT were 5.1 log IU/ml [IQR:4.0-5.8], 3.7 log IU/ml [IQR:3.4-3.9] and 90 U/L [IQR:55-150], respectively. During therapy, patients fit into four main ...

portal_hypertension.title: Predictive Value of Preoperative Thromboelastography, C-Reactive Protein, and Thrombomodulin for Postoperative Complications Following Hepatectomy in Patients With Hepatocellular Carcinoma.
portal_hypertension.authors: Hu Y, Shen W, Zhou H
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 195）。核心观点：肝切除术后并发症仍然很常见，并且与患者预后密切相关。 临床提示：传统的术前评估可能无法充分捕捉围手术期凝血障碍、全身炎症和内皮损伤。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Postoperative complications following hepatectomy remain common and are closely associated with patient prognosis. Conventional preoperative assessment may not adequately capture perioperative coagulation disturbances, systemic inflammation, and endothelial injury. This study aimed to develop and internally validate a multidimensional preoperative prediction model integrating thromboelastography (TEG)-related parameters with inflammatory and endothelial biomarkers. This single-center retrospective cohort study included 195 consecutive patients who underwent elective hepatectomy between March 2022 and May 2025. The cohort was randomly divided into a training set (n = 136) and a validation set...
